# João Pedro Magalhães

> Product Designer & Design Engineer in Portugal. UI/UX design, high-fidelity
> prototypes, design systems and branding, from Figma to code.

Product Designer and Design Engineer based in Barcelos, Portugal, also known
online as talvezjoaopedro. Works across product and UI/UX design, high-fidelity
prototyping, design systems, branding and frontend development, carrying work
from Figma through to production code.

## Focus

- Product design, UI/UX design
- High-fidelity prototypes
- Design systems
- Branding
- Frontend development: React, OutSystems
- Accessibility (WCAG)
